entry.title: New: dsh-niao-quick-open
entry.summary: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button. Exact install spec: dsh-niao-quick-open. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
